keyFindings.text: Independent documentation agrees with the patch text: `.dsh/SYNC.md` states the LLM Gateway route composes `agent-default-model` naming `llmgateway` and `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`, and the OpenCode Go route names `opencode-go` and `deepseek-v4.1-flash`; `.dsh/README.md` names `LLMGATEWAY_API_KEY` and `OPENCODE_API_KEY` as the credentials for the two routes. [SOURCE: .dsh/SYNC.md:111] [SOURCE: .dsh/README.md:67]

Route selection is model-driven: `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` selects `route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml`, every other allowlisted model selects `route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml`, and the selected route patch is passed to `dsh --patch` together with the lineage patch; the reasoning effort is pinned for the model at line 3048. This lineage's invocation metadata records model `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` at `reasoningEffort: max`, so the LLM Gateway route is the active one for this run. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs:3006] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs:3015] [SOURCE: specs/cli-external-orchestration/runtime-lifecycle/002-cli-deepseek-harness-creation/017-dsh-rc3-repin/research/fanout-rc3/lineages/dsh-rc3/invocation-metadata.json:1]

The LLM Gateway route patch configures provider `llmgateway` (display name "LLM Gateway") with `apiKeyEnv: LLMGATEWAY_API_KEY`, `api: openai-completions`, `baseURL: https://api.llmgateway.io/v1`, and `compat.thinkingFormat: deepseek` with `supportsDeveloperRole: false`. [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:5] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:7] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:9] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:11]

The LLM Gateway route patch declares one model, id `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` (name "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash"), with reasoning efforts `off` (empty), `high: high` and `max: max`, and it pins `agent-default-model` to provider `llmgateway`, model `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`, `reasoningEffort: max`. [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:14] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:16] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml:24]

The OpenCode Go route patch configures provider `opencode-go` (display name "OpenCode Go") with `apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY`, `api: openai-completions`, `baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`, and the same `compat.thinkingFormat: deepseek` / `supportsDeveloperRole: false` block; its header records that this endpoint is unverified until a keyed run proves it. [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml:6] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml:8] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml:10] [SOURCE: .dsh/patches/route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml:2]

The OpenCode Go route patch declares one model, id `deepseek-v4.1-flash` (name "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash"), with reasoning efforts `off` (empty), `high: high` and `max: max`, and it pins `agent-default-model` to provider `opencode-go`, model `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, `reasoningEffort: max`.
